opener: ashley (CHEER CAPTAIN ashley!!) ordered glitter from me for the competition!!! 12 jars, one per girl, in SILVER and EAGLE BLUE. i said YES because it's my first real order!!! i have a business!!! it's called Glitterpony Supply!! (it's me)

and i counted my glitter and i have SEVEN jars. and the craft store on route 9 is OUT. a lady said 'there's a shortage.' there's a SHORTAGE, malten. it's due saturday. ashley sent me a legend. it has colors.

choices.say: tell ashley the truth tonight. a short order delivered honestly beats a full one delivered late.
go on a quest. every drawer, every cousin, every craft closet within three miles.
post a bulletin: GLITTER EMERGENCY. trade horse portraits for jars. the site loves you.

them: tell her the TRUTH?? but i've never said no to anyone in my whole life!! i say yes and then i draw 14 horses at 2 AM!! ashley is the scariest person at my school and also once she said 'meg, you're doing great' and it was a [PINK] and i wore it like a medal for a week.
if i say 'seven' she'll say 'we'll find another vendor.' i'M the only vendor. there is no other vendor. there is me, and a lady at the craft store, and a shortage.

choices.say: say it plain: 'i have seven jars.' she can handle plain.
say it as a plan: 'seven now, five by friday.' captains like plans.

them: i wrote it with three bullet points, like her. '1. i have 7 jars. 2. i will have 5 more by friday. 3. i have no idea how.' (i took #3 out. i put 'i am working on it.') she replied in two minutes: '[RED] 5 more by FRIDAY. [GREEN] thank you for the plan. [YELLOW] I need to know HOW.'
so now i have to ACTUALLY get five jars by friday. i said the number out loud. it's real now. numbers are so mean.

effects.text: ashley!! glitter update from Glitterpony Supply: 1. i have 7 jars of silver + eagle blue ready for the squad. 2. i will have 5 more by friday. 3. i am working on it (very hard) (like a horse). love, meg

choices.say: then find them. every drawer, every cousin, every craft closet.
or ask the site. it's a big site. it has a lot of drawers.

them: ashley replied!!! in COLORS. '[RED] 7 jars. 12 needed. [GREEN] thank you for telling me on a WEDNESDAY and not on the bus. [PURPLE] what is the minimum viable sparkle per girl.' meg. a MINIMUM VIABLE SPARKLE. i've never been asked a question like that. i love it. i'm scared of it.
she says the four flyers on top need a FULL jar (so the judges can see them from row 20) and the base girls can have a pinch (row 3). i did the math on my arm. it works if everybody is nice about it.

effects.text: [GREEN] Meg: thank you for the honest number. [RED] The competition is Saturday, bus at 5:30 AM, no exceptions. [PURPLE] Flyers: full jar. Base: a pinch. I will accept a pinch if the pinch is real. [PINK] You're doing fine. (Don't tell anyone I used PINK.)

choices.say: tell her yes. tell her you'll do the pinch math tonight, in writing.
offer more than she asked: your unicorn jar, for the flyers. captains remember who showed up.

them: the pinch math!! a pinch is about a quarter teaspoon, which is about the size of a very small horse's sneeze. three jars for eight girls = a pinch each plus a little extra for the girl who's always last in line (it's a [PINK] thing). i made a chart. i used a RULER.
it works. it's honest. it's not a LOT of glitter. it's the amount i have. do i lock it in or do the other thing.

choices.say: lock it in. flyers full, base a pinch. send it. ask her to stamp it [GREEN].
lock it in, but the top of the pyramid deserves more than a pinch. give her the unicorn jar.

them: my unicorn jar. i've had it since i was 8. it's pink-gold and it has UNICORN on the lid in my handwriting. i said i'd open it the day i rode a horse for real. i've never ridden a horse for real. i've sat on one that was standing still in a field. visit #6 is soon. if i give it away, there's no 'first ride' glitter.
is that dumb? is it dumb to save glitter for a horse that doesn't exist yet?

choices.say: it's not dumb. but a promise to a horse isn't a promise to a jar. give it. the ride will make its own sparkle.
keep it. you're allowed. tell ashley exactly what you have and let her plan around it.

them: OK!! QUEST MODE!! i made a list!! 1. mom's craft closet. 2. cousin kelsey (she has a drawer of 'mistakes'). 3. ms. dolores at the stable (horse people always have sparkle). 4. the church rummage sale. 5. the girl behind me in homeroom (her pencil case glitters).
i have one flashlight and one carrot. where do i START?

choices.say: start at the stable. horse people always have sparkle.
start at mom's craft closet. moms always have glitter and don't know it.

them: results!!! mom's closet: 1 jar of 'wedding silver' from a very old wedding. a little yellow. very vintage. cousin kelsey: 1 jar that's 40% glitter and 60% dust (i didn't ask). ms. dolores: a pinch of 'show glitter' in a film canister marked HOOVES. it's PERFECT. total: 10 of 12!!

but the silver is the problem. the two missing jars are silver, and every jar i found is blue or pink or 'seasonal orange.' the squad is the EAGLES. you can't have eagles with orange sparkle. ashley would see it from space.

effects.text: glitterpony_meg has found glitter in three places glitter should not be: a wedding closet, a drawer of mistakes, and a film canister marked HOOVES. 10 of 12!! (the two missing jars are the silver ones) (of course they are)

choices.say: call tina. she laminates things. ask what she can do with a pinch.
the unicorn jar is pink-gold and it's the real thing. do it for the top of the pyramid.

them: i called tina (twilight_tina!! the lamination one!!). i said 'i have 10 jars and need 12' and she said 'how much glitter per girl' and i said 'a pinch' and she said 'meg. i can laminate glitter. 12 stickers per teaspoon. 25 cents a page, free if it's sad.' and i said 'it's GLITTER!!' and she said 'sad enough.' she's a genius.
a laminated glitter sticker is a sticker with glitter INSIDE, forever, no mess. the eagles could wear it on a cheek. NO FALLOUT. i didn't even think of it. what do i do?

effects.text: meg!! i can laminate 12 glitter stickers per teaspoon. free, it's an emergency. bring the glitter (any glitter) (even the orange) and i'll bring pouches. 4 PM. also: do you want a tiny horse on the stickers? asking for a friend (me) ~*~

choices.say: yes. laminate it. eagles on the front, a tiny horse on the back. sparkle that never falls off.
do the stickers AND give the flyers your unicorn jar for the top of the pyramid. best of both.

them: OK!! bulletin!! i wrote it in the kitchen at midnight!! 'GLITTER EMERGENCY!! SILVER + EAGLE BLUE!! IN EXCHANGE: ONE (1) HORSE PORTRAIT OF YOU!! NO REFUNDS!!' i hit post and then my mom walked in and asked who i was 'trading with' and i said 'the whole internet' and she said 'honey.'
it's been 3 minutes and there are already replies and i can't read them yet because my heart is going UNTZ (that's a nikki word). i've promised 40 horses. i have to DRAW 40 horses. i'm so happy.

effects.subject: GLITTER EMERGENCY!! (horses for glitter)
effects.text: HI EVERYONE!! this is meg (glitterpony supply). the cheer squad needs 12 jars of SILVER and EAGLE BLUE glitter by saturday and there is a shortage!! if u have any (any!!) (even a little!!) leave it on my wall or bring it to school. IN EXCHANGE: u get ONE (1) horse portrait, drawn by me, in MS paint, forever. no refunds. no take-backs. i promise 40 horses. i will draw 40 horses. thank u!! <3 meg

choices.say: read the replies. all of them. out loud to the stable animals.
wait. check your own house first, then read the replies. drawers before bulletins.

them: ok i read them!!! darkangel is sending a jar of BLACK glitter ('for tears') (she says it's 'the color of a horse that has seen things'). patrick sent a ROCK (it sparkles) (it's mica) (he says it's 'the one who listens'). linda sent 14 angel gifs and a candle (not glitter). zorp is sending 'a normal human amount of glitter (4 pounds).' FOUR POUNDS.
total: 38 jars. only 3 are silver. 4 are blue. one is 'rainbow.' one is a rock. one is 'tears.' i am rich and also everything is wrong.

effects.text: meg. the black glitter is not for the squad. it is for the one who stands at the back of the pyramid and thinks about the rain. i am sending it. use it for a tear. just one tear. ~*~ (i would like my horse to have a tear too.)
meg i sent you rocky's cousin. he sparkles. he's not glitter but he's the same idea. you can put him on the squad's bus seat. he listens. please draw me a horse made of rocks.

choices.say: sort it. someone has to. you own a ruler.
skip the sorting. call tina. she can make 12 stickers from one teaspoon.

them: sorting!! i made piles. SILVER (3). EAGLE BLUE (4). OTHER (31). ROCK (1). TEARS (1). zorp's four pounds is in a bucket. it's the biggest bucket i own. it's a horse bucket. it's sparkling like an actual horse that won an actual ribbon.
so i have 7 usable jars and 31 jars of every color except the ones i was asked for. ashley's legend does not have a color for 'other.' what do i do.

choices.say: forget sorting. use all of it. every color. tell ashley it's a 'bold look.'
use the usable 7 and stretch the rest. call tina. stickers.

them: i told her. i said 'i have what i have, and here's the plan.' she said '[GREEN]' and then she said 'thank you for not promising me 12 and handing me 7 on the bus at 5:30 AM. you have no idea how many people do that.' i didn't know that. i thought everybody told the truth. (my mom says i'm 'an optimist.')

the flyers got full jars. the base got a pinch each. the squad sparkled exactly where it counted. ashley wrote me a legend entry. my color is [SILVER]. it means 'dependable.' i have a color!! i have a COLOR.

effects.text: glitterpony_meg told the cheer captain the truth about the glitter shortage and the cheer captain said [GREEN]. she now has a color on the legend. it's [SILVER]. it means dependable. she is going to draw a horse about it.

[GREEN] Meg: Glitter was exactly what you said it would be. [SILVER] You are now on the legend: dependable. [RED] The squad placed 3rd and the flyers were visible from row 20. [PINK] You should come to the next competition. There's a seat on the bus. It's yours. (It has no horse on it. I checked.)

ok who is the 14 year old that told ashley the TRUTH about a deadline and lived. i need her tips. meg. xoxo. put me down for a horse. i want to be a palomino. (a palomino is the pretty one. don't tell me i'm wrong.)

them: i gave her the unicorn jar. i walked it to her locker and said 'for the flyers' and she looked at the lid (it says UNICORN in my handwriting) and didn't say anything for a second and then said '[...]' and i couldn't tell what color. then she said 'meg. i can't take this.' and i said 'you can.' and she held it like an egg.

the top flyer wore it on her cheekbones. she was the sparkliest person in the building. the judge said 'the top of the pyramid was luminous.' LUMINOUS. i drew the jar a horse. i'll open the next jar when i ride for real. (visit #6 is soon.) (it doesn't have to be pink-gold.)

effects.text: glitterpony_meg gave away her unicorn jar (pink-gold, 8 years old, saved for her first real ride) so the top of the cheer pyramid could glow. the judge said 'luminous.' meg drew the jar a horse. (it's a very proud horse.)

[PURPLE] Meg: I'm bringing something Saturday. It's a silver pom-pom from the squad's old set. A horse can have it for a tail. [RED] This is not a joke. [GREEN] When you ride for real, the horse wears the tail. [PINK] I wrote that on the legend.

Dear Meg, I once gave away my best fishing lure to a boy who had none. I have never regretted it. (I regret it every Tuesday.) A jar of glitter given freely is a kind of lure: it catches something good. Regards, Walt

them: we DID it!!! 12 stickers per teaspoon!!! tina laminated them in her basement (the laminator's name is Gloria) and each one has a tiny eagle on the front and a tiny silver horse on the back, where only the wearer knows. they didn't fall off. NOT ONE. the squad did a whole routine and the stickers stayed on and the judge said 'a unique detail.'
ashley said '[GREEN]. all [GREEN].' and then she said 'meg, you're on the bus next time.' i don't know what that means. i think it means a seat. i'm going to sit in it SO hard.

effects.text: glitterpony_meg and twilight_tina laminated glitter. 12 stickers per teaspoon. every cheer girl wore a tiny eagle with a tiny horse on the back. not one fell off. the judges noticed. (the laminator's name is Gloria.)

ashley is [GREEN]. glitter: done (via laminator) (do not ask how). squad placed 2nd. flyers visible from row 20. checklist item #14 is complete. next item: [PINK] thank the 14-year-old. (it's on the legend. it's a color.)

meg. 60 stickers. free. i'm keeping the leftover pouch with the horse on it. it's laminated. it's a very small, very sparkly horse. it's going on the fridge. also: you're my first glitter customer. my price is now 25 cents a page (free if it's sad). ~*~
meg i'd like to buy 12 laminated glitter stickers for my guild's pet pages. 40 NP each. i'll pay in NP or snacks. restock is at 4 AM so please send them to my wall (my wall will be awake).

them: so the squad went with EVERYTHING. all colors. the bus smelled like a craft store had a party. ashley stood at the front with the legend and said '[RED]... [PURPLE]... [BLACK GLITTER]...' and then she just said 'sparkle.' and the judges loved it. they said it was 'a bold look' and 'a lot.' we placed SECOND. second!!

there is glitter in the gym. there is glitter in the bus. there is glitter in the coach's coffee. the janitor sent a bill (to nobody). i drew 40 horses in 4 days. my hand is a claw. it's the best week of my life.

effects.subject: GLITTER DRIVE RESULTS (everybody gets a horse!!)
effects.text: HI EVERYONE!! the glitter drive is OVER and the cheer squad placed SECOND with 38 jars of every color on earth!! thank u darkangel (black glitter, 1 tear), patrick (mica rock), linda (candle), zorp (4 pounds, normal human amount), and everyone else!! i drew 40 horses and every single one has a sparkle. if u haven't gotten yours, look at ur wall!! <3 meg (glitterpony supply, now closed for glitter, open for horses)

ashley is [RED]. there is glitter in the gym. there is glitter in the bus. there is glitter in the coach's coffee. the squad placed 2nd. the judges called it 'a bold look.' [PURPLE] (this is not a complaint) [PINK] (it's a compliment) [GREEN] (the glitter will outlive us all)
meg. i saw the squad on the local news (11 seconds) and it was the most glitter i've ever seen on people and i've been to a prom. you are a LEGEND. put me down for 1 horse. xoxo

meg. the black glitter was on the back of the pyramid. one girl cried a single sparkling tear. it was the best moment of the competition. she said it was the glitter. i said it was the rain. ~*~ thank you for the horse.
